## What this issue is about
This issue addresses the enhancement and refactoring of the `contents` view in Plone, moving it to a new core package called `@plone/contents`. This aims to improve portability and usability, allowing it to be utilized in different frameworks.

## What needs to be done
The main tasks include:
- Refactoring `Contents.jsx` and its components using the Tanstack table library.
- Implementing better accessibility by using `react-aria-components`.
- Migrating to TypeScript and adopting `@plone/client` for API requests.
  
The exact discussion on when this will be implemented remains vague, with indications it might be included in Plone 6.2.

## Helpful background
This is part of a Plone Improvement Proposal (PLIP). The goal is to make the contents view more user-friendly and functional, ultimately focusing on a better user experience (UX). 

For more context, check existing related issues: [#5620](https://github.com/plone/volto/issues/5620), [#5677](https://github.com/plone/volto/issues/5677).

## Good first steps
1. Familiarize yourself with the existing `contents` view and its current implementation.
2. Explore the active discussions in the comments and linked issues for guidance.
3. Consider reviewing the docs on using `@plone/contents`, `react-aria-components`, and the Tanstack library.
4. Engage with the team by asking questions or sharing your thoughts on the direction of this enhancement.
